Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 32, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to three, one word per response.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.chunks.inspect
puts result.stream_content.inspect
puts result.stream_complete.inspect
```
